Alwyn is also found in the New Testament (Acts 27:7), where it refers to a Roman centurion. In Christian tradition, Alwyn is associated with nobility, friendship, and loyalty. This name is also associated with Saint Alwyn, a 7th-century Welsh saint known for his piety and devotion. In modern times, Alwyn is a popular name in many Christian cultures, symbolizing friendship, nobility, and faith.
